While carrying [[communications satellite]]s stolen from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on [[Orron III]], the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] [[Phoenix (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Phoenix'']] was '''ambushed''' by Imperial forces attempting to recapture the stolen [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]]. Before the Empire could capture the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] strike team arrived. Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], in a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], engaged Imperial forces while the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Wilsey]]'' boarded and captured the ''Phoenix''.
